$description: Kategoria component registry. Every UI component must be registered here with its token bindings. Reference sheet: references/refine-5-components.html

spec.pressableEdge: border-block-end {border.edge-width} solid <variant>-edge; pressed = edge 0 + translateY(5px) via {motion.easing.spring} {motion.duration.press}

accent.use: big moments only: New Game, celebrations

topbar.spec: Only chrome on game screens: back icon-button (48px, radius {radius.md}, bg {color.light.bg}) + bold title + optional settings icon-button at inline-end. Card-style container radius 20px.

modal.spec: Overlay {color.light.scrim} at 60% (dark theme: {color.dark.scrim}) at z {z.overlay}; panel: surface, radius {radius.lg}, padding {space.5}, centered, max 2 action buttons, big emoji allowed as illustration. z {z.modal}.

score-row.spec: Row: avatar circle 40px in player-N color with initial, bold name, score at inline-end in tabular-nums 800 20px. Bg {color.light.bg}, radius {radius.md}.

letter-tile.spec: 96px rounded square ({radius.lg}), bg {color.light.accent}, letter 56px 800 {color.light.on-accent}, shadow {shadow.card}. Scales up on shared/TV screen.

timer.spec: Pill ({radius.pill}), bg {color.light.primary}, text on-primary 800 22px tabular-nums. Under 15s: bg {color.light.danger} + scale pulse {motion.duration.pulse} (reduced-motion: color only).

icons.spec: One set only: outline style (Lucide), stroke 2.5, stroke-linecap round, sizes 20/24/32, color {color.light.text} or currentColor. No filled icon set, no emoji-as-icon in chrome (emoji allowed as content/illustration).

skeleton.spec: Loading lists: shimmer skeleton blocks (border/bg tones, 1.2s linear shimmer; reduced-motion: static block). Shapes mirror the content they replace.

spinner.spec: Short waits: 40px ring, 5px stroke, track {color.light.border}, head {color.light.primary}, 800ms linear rotation. Reduced-motion: static three dots.

empty-state.spec: Big emoji + one friendly bold line + one muted helper line + one action button. Example: 📭 'No saved games yet' / 'Start a new game and it will appear here!'

error-card.spec: Inline card: danger-tinted bg (#FFF5F5 light / danger at 12% alpha dark), 2px danger border, radius {radius.md}, plain-words message, ALWAYS offers an alternative action. Never a bare technical error.

focus-ring.spec: outline: 3px solid {color.light.focus}; outline-offset: 2px. Applied via :focus-visible on every interactive element. Never remove without replacement.
